name: SIABENCH
description: An agentic evaluation framework and dataset for security incident analysis tasks, covering deep analysis workflows and alert-triage scenarios. It supports benchmarking of large language models on diverse security tasks including forensics, malware analysis, phishing detection, and false-alert identification.
reputation: A niche but increasingly cited security-evaluation benchmark in the agentic LLM safety/incident-analysis space, with growing interest from researchers working on SOC-style workflows.
notes: First dataset covering a wide spectrum of security incident analysis tasks; benchmarks 11 major LLMs.
